notes: We Ötzi — 'A ustedes'. 60s manifiesto documental B&N + cierre ámbar local. 10 clips generados (kling3_0 pro, sound off, i2v desde stills cinematic_studio_2_5 2k 16:9) + end card ffmpeg. Escenas largas del guion partidas en dos tomas (4a/4b profesiones, 5a/5b símbolos). Sin oficinista (6 shots para 7 verbos del VO, el montaje fluye por encima). B&N se fuerza en post con hue=s=0; el ámbar solo existe en el end card. Regla anti-texto: toda letra tatuada se pide 'abstract illegible fine-line script' para evitar pseudo-texto de IA.
style: Black and white documentary photograph, 16:9 widescreen. Filmic monochrome with deep rich blacks, soft silver mid-tones and clean highlights; subtle organic film grain; natural window light or practical lamps only; authentic skin texture with pores and imperfections kept real; dignified real people, honest photojournalism in the tradition of Sebastião Salgado and Platon portraiture; no posing, no gloss, no fashion retouching, no aspirational stock-photo look. Absolutely no readable text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image; any tattoo lettering, sketch annotation or handwriting appears only as abstract, illegible fine-line marks.
